Native candidate decoding and resource qualification

decoder_ancestry.png: zlib deflate in the encoder and zlib inflate in the verifier, which the candidate native PNG decoder also uses; the verifier's own standard-library code reverses all five filter types and reconstructs samples, sharing no code with libpng

png-correctness.filter_selection: Scanline k of pass p, both counted from zero, takes filter type (k + p) mod 5. A noninterlaced image is pass 0, and Adam7 passes keep their numbers 0 to 6, so each type also starts a pass.

small-authored.applies_to: the small authored rasters behind every other PNG artifact; a payload fault names its source

timed.filter_selection: Each scanline takes the filter type 0 to 4 whose filtered bytes, read as signed two's-complement values, have the smallest sum of absolute values. The lowest type wins a tie. The choice depends only on the scanline and the previous scanline of its pass.
